reason: Could not run the evaluation: PyTorch 2.8.0 on this Apple Silicon host (macOS 26.2, 8 GB RAM, Anaconda python 3.12) raised SIGBUS (exit 138) reproducibly at the moment AutoModel.from_pretrained/from_config tries to materialize the BERT parameter tensors in CPU RAM. The failure reproduces with bert-tiny (4M params) too, so it is not a memory-size issue but a torch CPU allocator / mmap path on this host. State dict torch.load(..., mmap=True) works (verified — 201 tensors loaded), but allocating a fresh BERT (whether empty or pre-trained) bus-errors before any forward pass. HF base-SciBERT weights had to be downloaded mid-debug (the cache had only config.json + vocab.txt, no pytorch_model.bin and no model.safetensors); that download succeeded. The eval script itself is saved at component2_entity_relation_extraction/scripts/eval_scierc_relation_f1.py and matches the structure of eval_scierc_f1.py — only the run is blocked.
metric_note: If/when this can be run, it will be micro-F1 over the 7 SciERC typed relation classes (no_relation excluded), matching extract_relations_scibert.py dev metric. Expected range 0.50–0.70; <0.30 or >0.85 would indicate a bug.
